title: Export Live Metabolism Graph
description: Export the live Neo4j metabolism database to .repo/🛂/metabolism.cypher using the general generate script (bun ./script.ts generate neo4j metabolism).
summary: Exported live Neo4j metabolism graph to .repo/🛂/metabolism.cypher via NEO4J_EXTRA_GRAPH_DATABASES=metabolism and bun ./script.ts generate neo4j metabolism. APOC: 3780 nodes, 5980 relationships, ~1.06 MB. See ticket export-log.md.
